name: MS Teams (Office 365 connectors, retired)
reference: Legacy Incoming Webhook connector URLs; Microsoft switched off Office 365 connectors in Teams on 18-22 May 2026, so new hits point to stale tooling, and the pattern stays useful for historical log hunting - https://devblogs.microsoft.com/microsoft365dev/retirement-of-office-365-connectors-within-microsoft-teams/

name: Azure Logic Apps (formerly MS Teams Workflows)
reference: Request-trigger callback URLs of Azure Logic Apps. Power Automate and Teams Workflows URLs on this host were retired on 30 November 2025 (MC1183710) and replaced by *.environment.api.powerplatform.com - https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/logic-apps/logic-apps-http-endpoint

name: Telegram Bot API
reference: Infostealers routinely use Telegram bots as a fallback/primary exfil channel alongside Discord; text goes out via sendMessage and stolen files/archives via sendDocument - https://blog.nviso.eu/2025/12/16/the-detection-response-chronicles-exploring-telegram-abuse/

name: n8n Webhooks
reference: Cisco Talos: attacker-configured n8n webhook nodes used as a trusted-domain traffic distribution/C2 relay for malware delivery and device fingerprinting - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/the-n8n-n8mare/

name: ServerChan
reference: Commonly bundled as a WeChat push relay in notification/webhook-worker tooling - https://sct.ftqq.com/

name: Mattermost
reference: Incoming webhook pattern on self-hosted/cloud Mattermost instances - https://mattermost.com/

name: Zapier
reference: Named alongside n8n as a workflow-automation webhook relay abused for payload delivery - https://zapier.com/

name: ntfy.sh
reference: Public push-notification relay reachable with a simple HTTP POST to a topic name - https://ntfy.sh/

name: Google Apps Script
reference: Deployed web apps under a trusted google.com subdomain can relay POSTed data to attacker-controlled sinks (e.g. Sheets) - https://developers.google.com/apps-script

name: LINE Notify (discontinued)
reference: Service shut down on 31 March 2025 and all APIs stopped working on 1 April 2025; kept for historical log hunting. Its successor is the LINE Messaging API (api.line.me) - https://developers.line.biz/en/news/tags/end-of-life/

name: Healthchecks.io
reference: Simple GET/POST "ping" endpoint, suitable as a low-bandwidth beacon channel - https://healthchecks.io/

name: Gotify
reference: Self-hosted push notification relay with a token-authenticated POST endpoint - https://gotify.net/
